analyst.summary: Finolex Industries is a leading PVC resin and pipes manufacturer with an almost debt-free balance sheet, but recent results show real strain: revenue has stagnated, profit fell 25% in FY26, operating margins have swung wildly quarter to quarter (from as low as 1.3% to as high as 25%), working capital has deteriorated sharply, and a large share of reported profit came from non-operating other income rather than the core PVC business. We rate it a Hold, but flag the earnings-quality and working-capital trend as worth the portfolio manager's own review.
